Hon'ble Vinod Diwakar,J.
1 .  Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State-respondent, and perused the entire record.

2. This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed with a prayer to quash the entire proceedings of Case No.145 of 2016 (State v. Santosh Kumar) arising out of Case Crime No.35 of 2016, under Sections 452, 376 and 506 I.P.C., Police Station Hanumanganj, District Kushinagar,
pending in the Court of learned Additional Sessions Judge/FTC-II, Kushinagar, on the basis of a compromise.
3.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that since the parties had settled their dispute outside the court, therefore, concerned S.H.O. was directed to verify the compromise vide order dated 20.05.2025.

It is further submitted that since parties have settled the dispute, opposite party no.2 does not want to proceed with trial, therefore, no fruitful purpose would be served by keeping the Santosh Kumhar Alias Santosh Kumar ... vs State Of U.P. sentences.text: 4. Learned A.G.A. submits that from perusal of the verification report, it is revealed that applicant has solemnized marriage with the victim/opposite party no.2 and three children have been born out of the said marriage.
Since the dispute between the parties has been settled and opposite party no.2 has no objection, therefore, the proceedings of the aforesaid case pending before the trial court be quashed.
5. I have considered the submissions made by the learned counsel for the parties, and have gone through the entire record.

6. Since the dispute between the parties has been amicably settled, no fruitful purpose would be served by permitting to continue the criminal case pending before the trial court and it would simply a waste of judicial time as chances of conviction are very bleak.
7.

In such circumstances, the entire proceedings of Case No.145 of 2016 (State v. Santosh Kumar)
arising out of Case Crime No.35 of 2016, under Sections 452, 376 and 506 I.P.C., Police Station Hanumanganj, District Kushinagar, pending in the Court of learned Additional Sessions Judge/FTC-II, Kushinagar, against the applicant, are hereby quashed.
8. The instant petition stands allowed, accordingly.

Order Date :- 29.5.2025 A.N. Mishra (Vinod Diwakar,J.)
